controls.positive: every certified flip from the root
controls.negative: a wrong chamber (the flipped chart's spec reversed)

notes: Reusing labels verbatim across a flip (a wrong dictionary) is NOT caught on the pentagon: that map is trace-preserving there, so the control is a wrong trace, not a wrong dictionary.  The closed surfaces are not in this sweep: one flip of the four-punctured sphere's chart did not finish its trace comparison at q^2 within 900 s.

each flip commutes with rho: pentagon 2/2, heptagon 4/4, [A_1,D_3] 3/3, U(1)-gauged square 1/1, U(1)-gauged hexagon 3/3, [A_1,D_5] 5/5
